# Topology_Order_Constraint

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A constraint that defines the permissible ordering of computational steps based on the underlying network topology, rather than arbitrary scheduling. Guides the design of topology-centric architectures where the physical wiring dictates the optimal sequence of operations, reducing routing overhead.
